code = '''
from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=None; orient=None; pos=None
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg: line=row[0]; orient='h'; pos=i
    if line is None:
        for j in range(w):
            col={g[i][j] for i in range(h)}
            if len(col)==1 and next(iter(col))!=bg: line=next(iter(col)); orient='v'; pos=j
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,line)]
    ci=[c[0] for c in cells]; cj=[c[1] for c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ci),max(ci),min(cj),max(cj)
    obj=[[g[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg
    if orient=='h':
        nr0 = pos+1 if pos<r0 else pos-1-(r1-r0)
        for i,row in enumerate(obj):
            for j,v in enumerate(row):
                if v!=bg: out[nr0+i][c0+j]=v
        fr = nr0+len(obj) if pos<r0 else nr0-1
        for j in range(w):
            if out[fr][j]==bg: out[fr][j]=8
    else:
        nc0 = pos+1 if pos<c0 else pos-1-(c1-c0)
        for i in range(len(obj)):
            for j,v in enumerate(obj[i]):
                if v!=bg: out[r0+i][nc0+j]=v
        fc = nc0+len(obj[0]) if pos<c0 else nc0-1
        for i in range(h):
            if out[i][fc]==bg: out[i][fc]=8
    return out
'''
